name: 13 Letters
source:
Welcome to the dark and twisted world of a young college student. You are a freshman at the highly esteemed Genetix University. As you pursue an education, you have made new friends and enemies, you have gone to parties, and tried to find love along the way. Every choice that you make will have an impact on how your story plays out, but at the end of the night you will ultimately have to choose your fate.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.genetix.thirteen_letters]Google Play[/url]]
